SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND k_symbol = 'SLUZBY') AS statement_release_count, (SELECT DISTINCT k_symbol FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3 AND type = 'VYDAJ' AND amount = 3539) AS debit_3539_purpose;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) FROM district d JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 6000 AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT a.account_id FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.district_id, d.A2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS female_account_holders FROM district d JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2 ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC LIMIT 9;
